title: UNVERIFIED — Hawkesbury River, a Place That Does Not Exist

features.name: a double-storey white weatherboard hotel
features.desc-on-touch: Small windows and heavy blinds. Not a place for sleeping, on this occasion.

features.name: a willow beside the platform, a mathematics pamphlet
features.desc-on-touch: A light treatise about points on an elliptic curve and the relationship between falling autumn leaves and cryptography. She caught the earlier train.

features.name: warm bedside lamps
features.desc-on-touch: They make good on the promise made by the windows.

features.name: an orange tree and fallen fruit
features.desc-on-touch: In the pebble courtyard out the back, which also does not exist, and which is also thought about.

inscription: this place does not exist, and yet I think about it

file.note: A photograph whose contents list a place it could not contain.

reverie.title: REVERIE — a hotel that does not exist
narr: This place does not exist. You think about it anyway.
She caught the earlier train and waited beneath the willow, reading.
The lamps made good on the promise of small windows and heavy blinds.
You were not there to sleep. You knelt on the floor
Next day she departed first, arms down the sides of a thrift shop dress.
